[[Flamingo]]s are [[charmable animal]]s that can be found in parts of [[Istan]].

They always stand on one foot when idle.

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Nightfall]]
**[[Istan]]
***{{NPC location|Churrhir Fields}} (near Expert Rangers)
***{{NPC location|Issnur Isles}} (near [[:file:Buried Treasure Issnur Isles map.jpg|Buried Treasure]])
***{{NPC location|Mehtani Keys}} (southwestern island)
***{{NPC location|Plains of Jarin}} (southeast from [[the Astralarium]])
***{{NPC location|Zehlon Reach}}

==Quests involved in==
*[[Istan]]
**[[Flamingo-ing... going... gone.]]

==Notes==
*Evolved Flamingos deal [[piercing damage]], while Unevolved Flamingos deal [[slashing damage]].
